files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A restaurant menu by sections: a nav of section links, then each section (heading and note) with its dishes as
  menu lines (name, a dotted leader, the price; the summary and weight below). No cart. Axes: cols (1, 2), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { DishSection } from "./restaurant-menu.types";
import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";

export type RestaurantMenuProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  dishes: Dish[];
  sections: DishSection[];
  empty?: string;
  labels: FoodLabels;
  cols?: "1" | "2";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Badge from "../compose/Badge.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MenuSectionNav from "../components/menu-section-nav.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  dishes,
  sections,
  empty = "",
  labels,
  cols = "1",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<RestaurantMenuProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :tone="tone" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((sections?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="star" :title="empty" />
    <Stack v-else gap="8" align="stretch" :class="(((cols as string) === '1') ? 'mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl' : '')">
      <MenuSectionNav :label="labels.sections" :sections="sections" :prefix="id" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel" />
      <Box
        :class="
          (cols as string) === '2' ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-8 md:grid-cols-2'
          : 'flex flex-col gap-8'
        "
        data-testid="items"
      >
        <Stack v-for="s in sections" :key="s.id" gap="4" :id="tpl('{0}-{1}', id, s.key)" data-testid="menusection">
          <Stack gap="0" class="border-b border-border pb-2">
            <Title :as="3" size="xl" weight="bold">
              {{ s.title }}
            </Title>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ s.note }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-4">
            <template v-for="d in dishes" :key="d.id">
              <ListItem v-if="(d.tag === s.key)" class="flex flex-col gap-0" data-testid="item">
                <Box class="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                  <Inline class="font-semibold">
                    {{ d.name }}
                  </Inline>
                  <Badge v-if="d.badge" variant="outline" size="sm">
                    {{ d.badge }}
                  </Badge>
                  <Inline class="flex-1 border-b border-dotted border-border" aria-hidden="true" />
                  <Inline class="font-semibold">
                    {{ fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency) }}
                  </Inline>
                </Box>
                <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
                  {{ tpl("{0} · {1}", d.summary, d.weight) }}
                </Text>
              </ListItem>
            </template>
          </List>
        </Stack>
      </Box>
    </Stack>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
